caption: The video captures a close-up, static view of a circular metal plate fitted with short dark nozzles, from which many thin transparent liquid threads hang straight down and exit the bottom of the frame. Many threads hold a bulbous droplet near their upper end, while smaller bulges appear along several vertical lines. These discrete droplets and bulges translate downward along the hanging threads, including a prominent teardrop on the right and a droplet on the left. The plate and nozzles remain fixed, and the threads keep their vertical geometry without visible sideways movement. The upper bulbs near the nozzles stay roughly constant in size and position while lower portions continue out of view. A blurred figure in dark blue clothing and out-of-focus hands appear behind the apparatus. The visible process is ongoing throughout, with no detachment or pooling shown within the frame.
relations: Droplets and bulges translate downward along the hanging transparent threads while the threads keep vertical geometry.
The circular plate and dark nozzles remain fixed as liquid threads exit the bottom of the frame.
Upper bulbs near the nozzles stay roughly constant in size and position during downward droplet motion.
No detachment or pooling occurs within the frame while discrete droplets slide along vertical lines.
